model: FT1 thermal mass flow meter, BACnet MS/TP
applies_to: Fox Thermal FT1 gas thermal mass flow meters with the RS485 BACnet MS/TP option; the ONICON F-5500 manual prints the same four objects.
summary: The FT1 is an insertion or inline thermal mass flow meter for gases. With the RS485 option set to BACnet MS/TP it acts as a BACnet Smart Sensor with four Analog Inputs: flow, gas temperature, flow total and elapsed time since the total was reset.
notes: The manual lists the objects as plain text (Analog Input 1 = Flow and so on) without units or access; all four are listed read-only here and units follow the meter's display settings.
The ONICON F-5500 thermal mass flow sensor manual (DOC-0005059) prints the identical four objects; that meter reports ONICON's vendor ID 206 instead of Fox Thermal's 650.
The AI 3 label "Total Flow / Reset Total" suggests the total can be reset, but the manual does not say how to do it over BACnet; the front-panel reset is described.

source.title: Model FT1 Fox Thermal Gas Mass Flow Meter - Instruction Manual

integration.summary: Choose BACnet in the COM menu, set baud, MAC, Max Master, device instance and name, power cycle, then read AI 1 flow and AI 3 total.
setup: In I/O > COM set Comm=BACnet, then baud (9600-115200), MAC (0-127), Max Master, device instance (0-4194303) and device name (9 characters max).
A power cycle is needed before new communication settings take effect.
Device profile is BACnet Smart Sensor (B-SS); Fox Thermal vendor ID 650.
gotchas: Modbus RTU and BACnet MS/TP are only available if the RS485 option was ordered from the factory.
